# Cheltenham Open Data

> Cheltenham Open Data — the open data hub for Cheltenham and Gloucestershire. Live local data: fuel prices, house prices, flood warnings, air quality, planning applications, GP and pharmacy listings, food bank needs, classifieds, and news.

> All data is owned by the respective data providers; no liability is accepted for the accuracy of the data. Data is aggregated daily from official sources: the Environment Agency (flood warnings), HM Land Registry and ONS (house prices), Cheltenham Borough Council (planning applications), and NHS/Ordnance Survey (GP, pharmacy and Post Office locations), DEFRA for flood and air quality reporting.

## Data pages

- [Cheltenham Latest News](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-news): Local news aggregation in a simple view.
- [Cheltenham Classifieds](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-classifieds): Local jobs, services, items for sale, and community notices.
- [Cheltenham Helplines and Contacts](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-helpful-contacts-reports): Help and support contact numbers and links.
- [Cheltenham Cheapest Fuel Prices](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-fuel-prices): Local and cheapest fuel pricing data from 112 forecourts.
- [Cheltenham House Prices](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-house-prices): Local house prices data from Land Registry and ONS.
- [Cheltenham Planning Applications](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-planning-applications): Local planning applications from Cheltenham Borough Council.
- [Cheltenham GP and Pharmacies](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-gp-pharmacies): Find GP practices and pharmacies in Cheltenham.
- [Cheltenham Post Office Locations](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-post-office-locations): Find Post Offices in Cheltenham.
- [Cheltenham Fix My Street](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-fix-my-street): Local street issues and reports.
- [Cheltenham Flood Warnings](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-flood-warnings): Local flood warnings and alerts.
- [Cheltenham Air Quality](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-air-quality): Local area air quality readings for Cheltenham.
- [Cheltenham Food Bank](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-foodbank-needed-items): Local foodbanks and their needed items.
- [Cheltenham Public Holidays](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-public-holidays): Confirmed public holidays.
- [Cheltenham Security Alerts](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-security-alerts): National threat level from MI5, relevant given proximity to GCHQ, and Government Alerts.
- [Cheltenham Security Alerts](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-security-alerts): National threat level from MI5, relevant given proximity to GCHQ, and Government Alerts.
- [Cheltenham Recycling](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-recycling): Local recycling guides and recycling bank locations.
- [Cheltenham Public Toilets](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-public-toilets): Local toilets including baby changing facilities in Cheltenham.
- [Cheltenham Third Spaces](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-third-spaces): Local community hubs and third spaces in cheltenham

## Feeds & data sources

- [Sitemap](https://cheltenham-od.uk/sitemap.xml): Full list of site URLs.
- [Announcements Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/main.xml): Site announcements feed (Atom).
- [Flood Warnings Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/flood.xml): Flood warnings feed (Atom).
- [Daily News Summary Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/news-summary.xml): Daily news updates feed (Atom).
- [Cheltenham Classifieds Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/classifieds.xml): Classifieds feed (Atom).

## Other

- [Weather](https://cheltenham-od.uk/): Daily weather summary (temperature, wind, visibility, pressure, humidity, sunrise/sunset).
- [Farmers Market dates](https://cheltenham-od.uk/): 2nd and last Friday monthly (Jan–Nov); 2nd and 3rd Friday in December.
- [News](https://cheltenham-od.uk/news): Site news.
- [About](https://cheltenham-od.uk/about): About Cheltenham Open Data.
